name: Clear Conscience
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a few drops of wine placed on your tongue)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration permanent

DESCRIPTION

You lose all memory of events just prior to casting the spell. You lose 1 minute plus one round per level of memories that you personally experienced. This spell cannot negate charm, geas/quest, suggestion, or similar spells.
